text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: Someone's voice... Who on earth—

The plants here harbor the greatest power of the spirits.
Hehehe! Finally, the ingredients are all assembled!

text_block_list.name: Timid-looking Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
C-Can we really make one with this...?
An amulet, I mean...?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Of course I can make it.
It's a recipe straight out of Grandma's grimoire, after all.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
"Put these leaves in a pouch along with the herbs...
'Blessing of the Wind, come forth—'"

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
“Mother of all creation, gather the all-powerful mana,
assemble in my hand, and become my blessing—”

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
(...Ngh!?
What...? Was that a gust of wind just now...?)

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Here, it's a talisman of the wind spirit!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Even a scaredy-cat like you will be protected by the spirits.
With that, your spirit won't lose in a contest of wills.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: And if I win, don't you ever call magic a fairy tale again!

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
"That incantation, the mana, the wind spirits... and the wind that blew just now...
Even if it was just a coincidence—"
Hahaa! This is the best...!

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: !? What... was that unsettling feeling just now...!?

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
With this, my soul draws closer to the "Origin"...
There is no mistaking that, correct?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, to borrow your way of phrasing it, the effect of that medicine is...
"to touch upon a fragment of the sealed power."

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
You could say the eyes temporarily gleam with the radiance
of rubies from the aftershocks of leaking power... I suppose.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Well, strictly speaking, it's just a nutritional supplement, but it had the amusing side effect of making one's eyeballs glow.
So, I'd like to ask you to test its user experience.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Durandal, huh.
Did you... come seeking that as well?

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: Gimlet-san, what you just said—

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: ...Don't do it.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
"Don't step any further... not yet.
The power of the primordial 'Crimson' is too soon for you."

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: (Th... The primordial... 'Crimson'!?)

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
(Wh-What kind of terminology is that...!
I don't really get it, but... it feels so passionate!)

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: (And spirit energy... magic...)

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
I ' m   s o   j e a l o u s !
I   w a n t   t o   t a l k   a b o u t   t h i n g s   l i k e   t h a t   t o o !

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
...I believe I told you.
Not to pry.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
That power is too much for us to handle.
...As the wielder of the Holy Sword, I cannot overlook this.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Hoh. True... It's a dangerous power.
Yet it's also the power that will lead me to a new stage.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: "...So if I ever get consumed by the 'Crimson,' you make sure to stop me."

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Ah! Yes, without fail. With a single strike of my Holy Sword
...I shall banish the primal "Crimson"!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: Heh heh heh... It seems the 'awakening' of your soul has begun as well. I shall look forward to it.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: —And that is what happened!

The moment I showed up, she started telling me all about her chat with her friend.
Well, how should I put it... seeing her have fun is what matters most.
choice_data_list: A "Wind Spirit," huh... Magic is pretty cool, isn't it?
"The Power of 'Crimson'"... To think I'd hear that name again.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Right?! Having this sense of style appreciated
in everyday life... what a wonderful environment!

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
"I have reaffirmed that this is indeed
the place where I belong to fight!"

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: I'm going to ask Sweep-san to make me a talisman soon too!

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: "And I, too... will devote myself to unleashing a holy sword strike blessed by the spirits!"

“...Regardless of whether that kind of vibe works in daily life,
it was an afternoon where I was just glad to see her having fun.”

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
...! You knew about that?!
But that's Gimlet-san's—
choice_data_list: Only the radiance of a pure heart can battle against that.
Only the radiance of a pure heart can battle against that, you know.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: The radiance of a pure heart... In other words, the mark of a holy knight... is solely the radiance of the holy sword... to think that's what it was...!?

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
It was real... Nay, it *is* real...!
This world that I have stepped into...!

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: I cannot idle away! I must dedicate even more time to training my swordsmanship!
I only meant it as a joke, but it seems I've flipped some weird switch in her.
